sector_survival_note: Mastercard's moat is highly durable due to its long history of innovation and its strong position in the payment processing industry.
thesis_summary: Mastercard's payment processing network and innovative products ride the trend of increasing digital payments.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural change in the payment processing industry, such as a new competitor with a similar moat, would break the thesis.
sentiment_note: Valuation is rich, but the company's durability and moat make it a core hold.
ten_k_highlights: Mastercard's revenue has been rising at a rate of 73.6% over the past 5 years.
The company's return on invested capital (ROIC) has been increasing at a rate of 46.3% over the past 5 years.
Mastercard's share count has been falling at a rate of 8.7% over the past 5 years, indicating a reduction in dilution.
valuation_note: FCF yield 3.6%, PEG 1.6, EV/EBITDA 22, P/S 14 — priced ahead of fundamentals — accumulate slowly.
implied_growth_note: The price assumes reasonable growth the business can likely deliver.
